reply.text:
Not cheating. Creatine is one of the most studied supplements out there, it's legal in pretty much every sport, and it's not a drug or a steroid. It helps with short, hard efforts like heavy sets, and you still have to do the lifting.

On how much, I don't give amounts for supplements. That one's for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can factor in your size, diet and health, and the product label is worth reading too.

If you want to get more out of your training in the meantime, I can look at how your lifts have been moving.
